summary: Frontend-only e2e of Akash Mondal portfolio (single-page dark theme). Loader, navbar, hero, sections, footer, and second-visit-skip all verified on the public preview URL. 29 unique data-testids, 0 duplicates, 0 console/page errors.

Hero: name 'Akash Mondal' renders in serif italic; role rotator works ('A Founder' -> 'An Engineer' confirmed at ~2s interval with correct article 'An' for vowel-initial role); See works (#work) and Reach out (mailto:akash@miny-labs.com) buttons present

About: profile image + email link + resume link present; skill groups render (Chains text confirmed; other group headings present in DOM)
Selected Works (#work): 4 project links to GitHub repos (pixie, twinkle, Bunty, hestia) all open in new tab
Experience timeline: Miny Labs/Now badge + Freelance/Independent + Samsung + Yash all rendered

Footer: marquee text ('Crypto x AI primitives', 'Encrypted agent runtimes', 'AI primitives'... visually scrolling), 'Got a hard problem? Talk to me.' CTA, akash@miny-labs.com mailto button, 4 social icons (github/linkedin/twitter/email), copyright 2026 + V 2026.01 ALWAYS SHIPPING bottom bar
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Footer social testids use 'footer-social-email' (label='Email') while problem statement mentioned 'Mail'. Implementation is consistent and unique; no fix required unless main agent wants to align nomenclature with the spec.

HLS video does not decode in headless preview (paused, readyState 0). Hero falls back to dot grid + dark overlay gracefully — this is acceptable per the agent_to_agent_context_note. Real browsers/users will likely see the Mux stream play.
All sections code is well-modularized (under /components/portfolio/*) and uses portfolio-data.js as the single source of truth — clean architecture.
